profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC. On its own website, the company describes itself as an AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. It says its Autonomous Knowledge Platform is meant to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and it points to a product and service portfolio for AI, analytics, and cloud solutions. The site also states that the company partners with leading providers to deliver technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The site material does not name specific products, so no individual offerings can be listed here. The company's stated position is that of an AI and analytics platform provider serving organizations that want to adopt AI at scale.

Among the facts on record, the company has no tracked lawsuits and no tracked MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000816761.
